Simulate and integrate range scans

Source: R/mapping.R
grid_scans.Rd

grid_raycast() returns, for each beam angle (relative to the robot heading), the range to the first cell whose occupancy probability exceeds threshold, or max_range. grid_update_scan() performs the standard inverse sensor model update in log-odds: cells traversed by a beam before the hit receive l_free, the hit cell receives l_occ; beams at max_range only clear space. Log-odds are clamped to clamp.

grid_raycast(grid, pose, angles, max_range, threshold = 0.65)

grid_update_scan(
  grid,
  pose,
  angles,
  ranges,
  max_range,
  l_occ = 0.85,
  l_free = -0.4,
  clamp = c(-5, 5)
)

Arguments

grid

A robot_occupancy_grid.

pose

Sensor pose c(x, y, theta).

angles

Beam angles (rad) relative to the heading.

max_range

Maximum sensor range.

threshold

Occupancy threshold for ray casting.

ranges

Measured ranges.

l_occ, l_free

Log-odds increments.

clamp

Log-odds bounds.

Value

Ranges (grid_raycast) or an updated grid.

Examples

occ <- matrix(FALSE, 20, 20)
occ[, 15] <- TRUE
truth <- robot_occupancy_grid(c(0, 2), c(0, 2), 0.1, occupied = occ)
grid_raycast(truth, c(0.5, 1, 0), 0, max_range = 3)
#> [1] 0.9
